name: Winter Fantasy
blurb: Baldman Games' premiere Dungeons & Dragons Organized Play convention, held every February in Fort Wayne, Indiana since 1977.
notes: The seed URL wintfan.baldmangames.com no longer resolves (DNS failure on two attempts); the convention's current page is https://www.baldmangames.com/winter-fantasy/, used here instead. Winter Fantasy 50 (its 50th-anniversary edition) ran February 4-8, 2026 at the Grand Wayne Convention Center, Fort Wayne, IN - before this window starts (2026-10-05). The page still only talks about the 50th-anniversary show; no Winter Fantasy 51 / 2027 dates have been posted yet, so editions is empty.
